messages:
Asha (PM): Quick thread — RICE recalibration request for Q3 roadmap. We scored 'Adaptive routing v2' at R: 6, I: 8, C: 4, E: 5 => 240. After the CS sync, a couple enterprise customers asked for stricter SLA + per-customer routing policies. Need to discuss whether to adjust Reach or Effort. Thoughts?

Jon (Eng): If we add per-customer policy logic, Effort jumps to 8. Also latency could regress because of per-request policy eval. We should measure perf hit before we lock score.

Priya (Eng-ML): Impact may be higher for our top-10 customers — increases retention probability. But Reach might be lower (only a subset benefits). Suggest splitting into 'core routing' + 'enterprise routing' to separate scopes and get something shipped sooner.

Leah (Design): UX ask: admin panel needs clear routing rules and safe defaults. If we split, we should design the core admin flows as minimal and extensible. MVP mockups will help unblock eng.

Samir (Research): Also we should consider weighting Reach by ARR or customer tier, not raw requests. If enterprise traffic is 10% but 50% of ARR, Reach->Impact math changes. Happy to run a quick ARR-weighted sim.

Nadia (ProductOps): For launch criteria I propose: 1) e2e perf under SLA (p95 <= 150ms), 2) Feature flag + canary rollout to 10% orgs, 3) Telemetry for policy mismatches and fallback rates, 4) Runbook + docs for ops handoff.

Jon (Eng): Agree with split. For core routing we can keep Complexity=4, Effort=4. Enterprise addon will be Complexity=7, Effort=8. That will cause the two items to sort differently in the RICE sheet.

Asha (PM): Re-score proposal: Core routing: R6 I6 C4 E4 => RICE 144. Enterprise addon: R2 I9 C7 E8 => RICE 51. So core moves up and should be prioritized this quarter. Any objections?

Leah (Design): :thumbsup: core-first makes a lot of sense. We'll prepare minimal admin flows to avoid rework when enterprise features come in.

Priya (Eng-ML): Small flag: instrumentation for the enterprise addon needs synthetic "gold" customers so we can validate fallbacks and routing correctness in tests. I'll draft the test matrix.

deploy-bot: Reminder — staging capacity test scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Please ensure prototypes are deployable to the staging pool.

Asha (PM): Action items: Jon -> prototype core routing by EOW; Leah -> admin mockups by Wed; Priya -> telemetry & synthetic test plan by Thu; Nadia -> update launch criteria doc and link it in the sheet. I'll update the RICE sheet and ping SLT for greenlight. Thanks everyone.

Jon (Eng): On it.

Priya (Eng-ML): Will add synthetic test plan to the ticket and tag @Asha.

Leah (Design): I'll post mockups in #design later today.

Asha (PM): Closing — we'll reconvene Fri for the recalibrated final scores. :calendar:
